description: Loads a multi-file exercise from a source repository by first fetching a metadata descriptor and then fetching each listed file. The descriptor supplies the exercise name and the file list; an optional branch reference is appended to every request. A file may declare an alternate path that is used to fetch its content while keeping its logical name. The output reports the first requested URL, the HTTP status, the exercise name, and the content of a selected file.

cases.expected_output:
request=https://api.github.com/repos/owner/repo/contents/basic/dartpad_metadata.yaml
status=200
description=A Dart Exercise
main.dart=this is main.dart

request=https://api.github.com/repos/owner/repo/contents/alt_branch/dartpad_metadata.yaml?ref=some_branch
status=200
description=A Dart Exercise
main.dart=this is main.dart

request=https://api.github.com/repos/owner/repo/contents/alternate_path/dartpad_metadata.yaml
status=200
description=A Dart Exercise
test.dart=this is test.dart

request=https://api.github.com/repos/owner/repo/contents/unnecessary_file/dartpad_metadata.yaml
status=200
description=A Dart Exercise
unnecessary.txt=this is unnecessary.txt
